patches.title: The Nameless Admiral changes course
items: The Nameless Admiral (Campaign 9-10) no longer heals from his damage. Instead, every fourth attack knocks the hero he hits 15 m back with bonus damage, and every hero they pass through is hit too.
The red upgrade dots in the Heroes panel are brighter.

patches.title: Arena Top Pick and a new Record
items: Top Pick shows the 10 most liked Arena battles on the server. Watch any of them and give it a thumbs up or down.
The Arena Record is a new pop-out with both teams on every fight.
The Defenders frame fits your five heroes snugly.
Rafe's Pirate's Instinct now grows with its level: every fourth attack, melee or ranged, deals 50% bonus true damage at level 1, up to 200% at level 100.

patches.title: Arena: always someone to fight
items: You always see at least 4 Arena opponents, at any rank.
In the top 10 you can challenge everyone else in the top 10.
Opponents can be found further up the ladder, so the climb is faster.

patches.title: A cleaner Vault
items: The Vault shows the Gatekeeper as a button next to the floor banners; tap it for the boss and the Vault rules. On normal floors it is an Info button.
The floor drops box is taller so every reward fits.
The Academy and both Markets fit tablets and large phones.

patches.title: Fits every phone
items: Holding your phone upright, or using a Z Fold, now shows the same screen layouts as holding it sideways.
An unfolded Z Fold held upright now fills the screen instead of a thin strip.
Arena opponent refreshes are free and unlimited.

patches.title: Diamond Patron and a sharper screen
items: Ember Diamond Patron has its own new look.
The Vault uses its new layout on every screen size.
Panel frames no longer blur the art behind them.

patches.title: New titles and real rewards
items: The Vault and the Forge have new title art.
Reward screens now show the real item you earned: gear fragments, XP potions and hero fragments each have their own picture.
The Forge item rows are wide enough for every hero card.
Each diamond pack in the Store now shows how many Base Diamonds it gives.

patches.title: Your gear, updated
items: Gear your heroes are already wearing has been changed to their new items for free, and it keeps its Temper.

patches.title: Gear for every hero
items: Every piece of gear is now used: each hero has their own nine items, and heroes are spread evenly across the items that suit them.
Five items had a stat changed to suit their heroes: Warden Circlet, Fluxwalk Sabatons, Ashstride Boots, Astral Carapace and Leyline Sash.

patches.title: The Forge
items: The Forge list has thicker rows, larger hero faces and bigger quality tabs, and the title no longer appears twice.

patches.title: Rewards and the Vault
items: Stage and sweep rewards now use the same art as the Bonus Stage claim.
Clearing a Vault floor shows a row of the real items you won.
The Vault now fits on one phone screen, with bigger hero cards.

patches.title: Campaign banner
items: The Campaign chapter banner now fits the chapter name and arrows, and sits right under the top bar.

patches.title: Small fixes
items: Buying Arena Coins at the limit no longer takes your diamonds.
The Guild shop now counts only the items it really has.

patches.title: Arena portraits
items: Arena hero portraits are larger on bigger screens.

patches.title: Arena
items: In the Arena, Defenders, Rules, power and Adjust now sit above the defender banner, and your defenders sit closer together. The whole Arena now fits on one phone screen.

patches.title: Patron display
items: The Ember Gold Patron screen has new art: a golden phoenix crest and a gold-framed panel.
Bonus stage name plates on the campaign map no longer sit under other stages.

patches.title: Forge list fix
items: The Forge's equipment list no longer has a large frame drawn over the item cards.
The City Wall tab's durability bar shows again, and its last rows are no longer behind the frame.
Building panels keep their text clear of the gold frame corners.
Forge: the qualities are tabs on the right again, one compact row per piece of equipment, all qualities on the side.
Building screens fill wide phone screens.
Guild Hall: the chat tab sits in the same place as the other guild tabs.
Patron screen: every EGP / EDP page is the same size, so the arrows stay put.

patches.title: New building screens
items: Every building's main screen has new painted art and a new look: Academy, Market, Shady Market, City Wall, Witches Hut, Bulletin Board, Vault, Arena, Watch Tower, Guild Hall, Forge, Wishing Pool, Campaign and the Island of Trials.
The Academy's research is now eight labelled cards.

patches.title: Emberdraft's new entrance
items: Emberdraft has a new painted entrance: title, Play button, avatar tray and reward plates.
EDP patrons hit city walls harder: up to +10% per hit at EDP 15. City walls recover faster at EDP 2, 5, 8 and 10.
KonWu's lore now plays in his own voice.
Hero Survivors: Morvayne swings his mace, and his heal, shield and ultimate stay on him.
The hero window is as wide as the Heroes list.

patches.title: Campaign shops and Spire spells
items: The + next to food and diamonds on the campaign screen now opens the shop right there.
Hero Survivors: hero spell art now plays behind your hero and is sized to them.
The Patron screen is centred, with arrows to browse every EGP and EDP level's benefits.
Building names no longer show through the open menu.
A mine trip left waiting on another device now finishes and pays its haul.
No mute button on the campaign screen.

City Wall: your wall now has durability. Lost defenses wear it down (by the attacking line's size, less when your Academy is above the attacker's level); at 0% your castle is destroyed and rebuilt elsewhere in your region. It repairs 4% an hour, or 25% for 200 diamonds, on the new City Wall tab - which also sells attacks.

patches.title: A new look for your base
items: Your base screen has a new forged-gold look: resource bars, commander and EGP plates, the menu, the sound button and chat.
Tapping a building's name always opens that building.
The EGP button opens on a tap on phones.
The base screen's buttons sit closer to the edges, leaving more room for your town.

patches.title: Sweeps and upgrade dots
items: Guardian, boss and elite stages can sweep all their remaining runs at once (Sweep x3).
The Chances count on a stage goes down as soon as you sweep, and the reset button appears without leaving the stage.
A red dot on a hero's card shows an upgrade is waiting (gold for a skill, glyph fragments or equipment fragments), and a red dot marks each tab that has it.
The campaign map's top bar is tidied into one row: Base, stamina, stars, diamonds and Glossary, all the same size and style.
Your base screen is rearranged: your commander and EGP sit top-left, food, gold and diamonds top-centre, and the menu top-right.

patches.title: Campaign rewards
items: The campaign map now shows your stamina and diamonds.
After you win or sweep a stage, your rewards pop out one at a time, each with its own art.
The 'locked into the board' message on the glyph screen now shows in front of the hero window.

patches.title: The Swarm Spire in 2D
items: Every hero now plays the Swarm Spire with their own battle animations: idle, walk, attack, skills and ultimate. All 61 heroes are playable.

patches.title: Dandra's Queen's Call
items: Dandra's Queen's Call effect is smaller again, so it no longer covers your heroes. Its healing is unchanged.

patches.title: Dandra's Queen's Call
items: Dandra's Queen's Call ultimate effect is now 20% smaller. Its healing is unchanged.

patches.title: Boss passives fixed, gear in hero power
items: Sable Vesper's Dirge Crescendo now heals her allies as her card says.
Maelvara's Fury now gives her +25% attack speed.
The Nameless Admiral now heals for 20% of the damage he deals.
Crit resist, healing power and penetration on your equipment now count in hero power.

patches.title: Monster classes and a harder campaign
items: Every monster and boss now has a real class (Tank, Bruiser, Mage, Marksman or Support) and fights from that class's position. Casters like Leviath and Volthex now use Ability Power.
Monster Armor and Magic Resist now match their class: tanks are very tough on one side, mages have low Armor and high Magic Resist.
Campaign chapters 7 to 16 are harder: enemy health and damage are up 3% to 53% depending on the chapter.
The Glossary now shows every ability of heroes, monsters and bosses with its real numbers.

patches.title: Magmourn reworked
items: Magmourn's Ignite All now burns every hero within a 20 m wide ring of fire around him (was 40 m).
Magmourn's Fireball is now a real fireball thrown from his hand at your weakest back-row hero, burning everyone within 5 m of where it lands.
Magmourn has 30% more Ability Power.

patches.title: Monsters with a real stat
items: Every monster and boss now has Ability Power or Attack Damage instead of a plain Damage stat, and its abilities scale off it. Casters deal magic damage (blocked by Magic Resist), the rest physical (blocked by Armor).
Magmourn is now a mage tank: he holds the front line, his Fireball always targets your weakest back-row hero, and Ignite All burns every hero within 20 m.

patches.title: The campaign bites back
items: Every campaign enemy, chapters 1 to 16, is 5% stronger - health and damage - and each stage's recommended power rises with it. Elite and Veteran follow.

patches.title: Every gain counted once
items: Campaign chapters 10 to 16 are rebalanced around enemies that now use their skills at their own level: the climb is steady from chapter 10 to the end, and the last stages stay a real challenge for a strong level 85 team.
Campaign chapters 6 to 9 are 5% easier, and the chapter 7, 8 and 9 bosses were brought back to the difficulty they had before enemy skills levelled up.
Rhukk's Impale Rush now hits for 200% of Attack at skill level 1, rising to 300% at level 100 (it reached 394%).
Fixed: Vireo's Grand Symphony and Mellan's Hivemind heals counted the skill level twice - they now grow with the skill level once, as their tooltips say.

Fixed: shields from Reinforced Seam, Sanctuary Guard, Thunder Guard, March and Imperial Plumage never expired and stacked with every cast - they now refresh and last 5-6 seconds. Trail of Splendor still stacks, but now expires.
Fixed: an expired speed, damage or damage-reduction buff could make the next, weaker buff as strong as the old one; and two overlapping control-resist buffs could leave a permanent bonus.
Fixed: Grimsby's Compound Interest lengthened some damage-over-time effects twice.
Veyr's Weightless Predator: the crit chance he gains from dodging now resets at the start of every wave.
Quorrel's Tireless and Carn's Unrelenting now also speed up their attacks in server-run battles, and count in their power. Academy Crit Resist and Healing research now count in hero power too.
Fixed: Hollow's server-side Attack still used his old value (40); it is now 36, the same as in battle.

patches.title: A little more bite
items: Campaign chapters 10 to 16: enemies are 5% stronger - health and damage - and each stage's recommended power rises with them. Elite and Veteran follow.
Campaign and Vault enemies now use their skills at their own level instead of level 1 - a level 70 enemy casts like a level 70 hero.
Rhukk - Carapace: 20% less damage taken (35% at skill 100). Thick Chitin: 3% less damage every 3 seconds in combat, up to 15% (25% at skill 100).

patches.title: Teeth again
items: Campaign chapters 10 to 16: enemies hit hard again. Their damage is back to at least 80% of what it was before last update, and they have less health instead, so the fights are short and dangerous. The chapters now climb to a level-85 team at the end of chapter 16; Elite and Veteran follow.
Damage over time - burns, bleeds, poisons, curses and lingering ground effects - is now reduced by the target's Armor or Magic Resist, the same as every other hit.

patches.title: Fair fights
items: Campaign chapters 10 to 16 are rebuilt around one rule: a level-80 team with the best quality, gear (+7), a 3-dot prayer, 5 stars and level-80 skills clears 16-10, and every stage before it is set the same way for its level. Late stages get much easier, the recommended power on each stage now matches real hero power, and Elite and Veteran follow at 1.5x and 2x.

Rhukk - Carapace: 35% less damage taken (45% at skill 100), 10 second cooldown. Dig In: 10% less damage (20% at 100), and every enemy attack that hits him during the taunt heals him for 1% of his max health.
Vael - Last Stand: 50% less damage taken (70% at skill 100). Heals up to 20% of his max health (30% at 100) - the lower his health, the bigger the heal.
Grosk - Croc Drop: the team takes 20% less damage (35% at skill 100) for 3 seconds. Hammer Fists now hits for 20% of his Armor per punch (30% at 100) instead of his attack.
Bitwraith: Corruption deals 15% less damage.

patches.title: A fairer climb
items: Campaign chapters 11 to 16: every stage is 15% easier - enemy health and damage are lower, and each stage's recommended power drops with them. The bonus stages of those chapters ease off too, and Elite and Veteran stay 1.5x and 2x the new Normal stages.
Campaign chapter 10 now climbs smoothly from the end of chapter 9 to a 24,000-power boss at 10-10 (it was 26,934).

patches.title: Feet on the ground
items: Aldren no longer slides during his hit reaction, Ink Spirit cast and passive - he stays planted where he stands.
Temple of Ash: Multi pray is open from the start - pray up to 10 times in one go; prayers that lower power are dismissed automatically.
Temple of Ash: the Flame / Diamonds choice under Pray is readable again.

patches.title: A cleaner Forge
items: The Forge opens straight to your items - the extra tabs are gone and the list now fills the screen.
Settings > Storage: if your device runs out of room while saving the game's art, it now tells you so, instead of pretending the download finished.

patches.title: The Glass Minotaur wakes
items: Orryx, the Glass Minotaur (the 8-10 boss) is tougher. Labyrinth Charge now knocks every hero in his path 5 meters aside for full Attack damage, then slams the hero he reaches for 150% and stuns them for 3 seconds.
Prismatic Axe now hits the weakest hero within 3 meters with three rapid axe swings.
Orryx swings a little slower but hits harder, and has more health.

patches.title: Temper without limits
items: Temper as fast as you like: twenty, fifty, a hundred taps in a row now all count, and the Forge no longer stops answering after a burst of tempering.
Hero Equipment tab: if the Forge does not answer for a moment, the tab now retries by itself instead of showing an error.
Bonus Stage: claiming now shows every fragment you won right in the panel, one after another, each with its own fragment art.
Sign-in: we now record why a Google or Facebook sign-in is turned down, so we can fix the ones that fail.

patches.title: A painted Forge and Bonus Stage
items: The Forge has a new look: a lit forge hall, painted item rows and quality tabs, and a molten Temper bar in the item window.
The Bonus Stage panel is redrawn around the glowing glyph bowl, and the Claim button now always stays on screen on smaller phones.
Phones: when many heroes fall at the same moment, the game now keeps their death animations inside the phone's memory limit - a few may simply fade out instead.

patches.title: A new Forge and a fairer Starless Well
items: The Forge is rebuilt: pick a quality on the right and see every item of it, its Temper, and which of your heroes use it. Tap an item to see its stats and temper it.
Starless Well: the enemy heroes are 30% weaker, and chests, tents and springs now ask before you take them and show you exactly what you got.
Chat: the Whispers tab now sits in line with World, Region and Guild.

patches.title: The Bonus Stage pool
items: New on the campaign map: tap the glowing glyph bowl in the bottom-left corner to open your Bonus Stage pool. See what you earn per hour for each glyph quality, how much is saved (up to 36 hours) and when the next hour lands, then claim it all with one tap.
The Normal, Elite and Veteran tabs on the campaign map take up less space.
The store's TEST PACK now sits in its own Limited tab.

patches.title: Tap to play
items: The opening screen now clearly says Tap to play, so nobody is left waiting on it.
New players' games now quietly tell us how far they got if something goes wrong on their device, so we can fix it fast. No names or personal details are sent.

patches.title: More diamonds in every pack
items: We've made the diamond packs bigger: $9.99 now gives 1,250, $19.99 gives 2,600, $49.99 gives 6,600 and $99.99 gives 13,400 diamonds. The $4.99 pack stays at 600.
The big pack is now $49.99, in line with the rest of the store.

patches.title: Your gear works on auto now
items: Heads up, heroes: when you fight on auto, your heroes now use their equipped gear active on their own. You no longer have to tap it.
Gear that waits for low health still waits, so your Heartward Pendant saves itself for when it matters.
This window now shows our last 3 updates, so you can catch up on anything you missed.

patches.title: Bosses brought backup
items: Bosses were going down too fast, so we toughened up their escorts. In the Campaign (Normal, Elite and Veteran) and the Vault, the monsters fighting beside a boss now have 20% more health. Bosses and heroes are unchanged.
New: after every update we will show you what changed, right here, the next time you open the game.

patches.title: Fritz calls the storm where you want it
items: You told us Fritz's Thunder Shower was missing, and you were right. You can now aim it: drag to choose where the storm lands. On auto it lands on the enemies.
The storm covers 6 m around that point and hits everyone inside it every half second.

patches.title: The world map is back
items: The full world map is restored: every city, the floating World Tree island with its waterfalls, and the detailed terrain are back on the map.

patches.title: Maelvara grows stronger
items: Maelvara, Stormnest Matriarch (the Chapter 7 boss) has 15% more health.
Thunder Talons: each strike also deals an extra 30% as magic damage.
Cyclone Choir: the storm field is now 10 m across and deals 15% more damage.

patches.title: A $1 store test pack
items: The shop lists a TEST PACK for $1.00. It is a real Google Play purchase used to test payments - please do not buy it. Every other pack stays free.

patches.title: Use many XP potions at once
items: On a hero's Stats tab, type how many XP potions to use (1-999) next to each potion. It stops at your Commander level cap, so no potion is wasted.

patches.title: More Gold wish heroes
items: Gruel, Sorrel and Yenna Cacklefang are now 1-star heroes and join the Gold wish (10 heroes). Anyone who already has them keeps their stars.

patches.title: Morvayne's card
items: Morvayne's card art sits lower so his helm and crown are no longer cut off by the card frame.

patches.title: Every hero can be earned
items: Every 2- and 3-star hero is now in the Diamond wish, every 1-star hero in the Gold wish, and every Mythical in the Mythical Pool - 31 heroes who could not be wished for before now can.
Grosk and Zahri Sunhorn are Arena heroes: their fragments are sold in the Arena shop.
Oakmir: Mending Bloom cooldown 6 -> 7 s, Rally Roots cooldown 9 -> 10 s.

patches.title: Arena refills
items: Buying Arena attempts now refills you to a full 5 in one purchase (50 diamonds, up to 5 refills a day) instead of one attempt at a time.

patches.title: Morvayne finishes every spell
items: Morvayne plays each King's Mercy and Shelter of the Crown to the end before starting the next - no more cut-off casts.

patches.title: Morvayne stays on the ground
items: Morvayne no longer floats up off the ground while he casts - his feet stay in the same spot in every animation.

patches.title: Spells charge the ultimate
items: Every hero now gains energy from casting a skill, the same as from an attack - ultimates come round faster, most of all for spellcasters.
Morvayne no longer slides onto the field casting - he walks in with the team, then starts healing.

patches.title: Morvayne casts without stopping
items: Morvayne stands one head lower on the battlefield.
Morvayne casts King's Mercy and Shelter of the Crown non-stop instead of waiting for an ally to be hurt.
Morvayne no longer slides across the ground while casting - he finishes the cast, then walks.

patches.title: Morvayne holds his ground
items: Morvayne no longer slides when he is hit or sinks into the ground when he dies - he stays planted in every animation.
Morvayne's card uses the close-up portrait.
Cleaner shield dome on Morvayne's ultimate over bright backgrounds.

patches.title: Morvayne's new look
items: Morvayne has new art: card, idle, walk, attack, both spells, his ultimate and his death.
Blade in the Dark: if you already own Vex, the quest now pays 7 Vex fragments instead of nothing.

patches.title: Quests, equipment and Mythical heroes
items: Quests you finish during a session can be claimed straight away - no reload needed.
Equipment shows fragments you just won in the Vault without a reload.
Mythical heroes now say where they really come from: the Mythical Pool, which opens at EGP 11.

patches.title: Hero screen fixes
items: Equipment now names each hero's loadout in plain words (for example Tank / Attack / Front).
A skill's upgrade button is greyed out once the skill matches its hero's level - level the hero to raise it further.

patches.title: Stage 14-7 eased
items: Campaign stage 14-7 is a little easier on Normal, Elite and Veteran: enemy health and damage lowered by 15%.

patches.title: Facebook sign in
items: Sign in with Facebook is now available next to Emberweave and Google sign in.
Settings > Account: link Google and Facebook side by side.

patches.title: Facebook sign in (coming soon)
items: Facebook sign in and account linking are built and will switch on once the Facebook app is approved, next to Emberweave and Google sign in.

patches.title: The whole game in your language
items: Every screen, tab, popup and battle panel now follows your language setting, not only the first screens.
Skill descriptions, passives, ultimates, hero lore and the bestiary are translated into all 15 languages.
Server messages (errors and warnings) now appear in your language. Hero, skill, item and place names stay in English.

patches.title: Heroes list, four across
items: The Heroes list is now four cards across and sits in the middle of the screen, so it is easy to reach with either hand.
Settings: the Danger zone is now the last section of Account, below Google linking.

patches.title: Two ways to sign in
items: The sign-in screen now has two buttons at the top: Emberweave sign in with your username and password, or Google sign in with your Google account.

patches.title: A sharper world map
items: Much more of the world map now has fine painted detail when you zoom all the way in: coasts, seas and lands across the realm.
Sign in with Google: continue with your Google account on the first screen, or link it to your account in Settings.

patches.title: A tidier Settings
items: Settings is now one tidy panel with tabs: General (language and sound), Account, Storage, and Support.

patches.title: Morvayne
items: The Mythical Support hero now has his name: Morvayne, The Open Gate.

patches.title: A new big-heal cast
items: The Mythical Support hero's big heal has a new cast: his mace and shield runes flare with clean purple light before the heal lands.

patches.title: Choose your language
items: The game now speaks 16 languages: pick yours on the new Language card at the top of Settings, or let the game follow your phone. Menus, town buildings, screen titles, Settings and common buttons are translated first; more of the game follows.

patches.title: A new Mythical Support hero
items: A new Mythical Support hero joins the Mythical Pool, healing allies with dark-purple energy and protecting an ally with a dark-purple shield.

patches.title: A new look for the website
items: The website has a fresh look: a featured hero showcase with each hero's story, new paintings for every feature, framed game mode and hero cards, and embers rising over the splash.

patches.title: Energy bars
items: Hero energy bars in battle always show the real energy, and the ultimate only lights up when the bar is full.
In the first battle, Vireo's and Sylthaine's energy fills up steadily before their first ultimate, and Sylthaine joins a few seconds into wave 2.

patches.title: Ready, then fight
items: At the start of every wave in every mode, heroes and monsters walk to their spots and stand ready for a moment before the fight begins.
Speech bubbles in the first battle point right at the speaker's head and show over the wave timer.

patches.title: Battle cries
items: In the first battle, Vael's battle cry now pops up one shout at a time.

patches.title: Bigger heroes
items: Every hero and monster is 15% bigger in battle, and every range, reach and ability area grows with them, so fights keep their feel.
Speech bubbles in the first battle sit right above the speaker's head.

patches.title: No stamina cap
items: There is no longer a 999 limit on stamina you hold: meals, Ember Roasts and rewards always add in full.

patches.title: Speed and Auto
items: 2x battle speed is free for everyone once you clear stage 1-3, and the speed button flashes the first time so you find it.
Half speed is only for watching arena and world map replays.
Auto ultimates open at EGP 1 or player level 30; the button shows a lock until then.

patches.title: Your first battle
items: Stage 1-1 is now a story fight: Vael charges in alone, Vireo and Sylthaine join him, and they show you how to use each ultimate.

patches.title: An easier start
items: Every monster, boss and enemy in the campaign, Elite, provinces, the Starless Well, the Vault, dungeons and raids is 5% weaker (all stats). PvP is unchanged.
The first tutorial step's button is always on screen on phones.
The sign-in, Terms of Service and Start Here screens have new gold frames, and sign-in sits in the middle of the screen.

patches.title: Username stays yours
items: Your username (what you sign in with) never changes. Renaming changes only your nickname, the name other players see. Your profile shows both.

patches.title: Bug or Suggestion
items: Reports: choose Bug or Suggestion before you send, so your idea reaches the right list.

patches.title: Full-screen world map
items: The world map fills the screen at full zoom out: no more plain sea box around the edge of the map.

patches.title: Never kicked from a fight
items: Battles are never interrupted when the server goes down: the fight finishes on your device and its result is saved when the server is back.
Mines hold resources: tap a mine to see what is left. It stays on the map until it is empty, and retreating takes nothing from it.
The World Tree and the oases can only be taken during the World Tree event; holders lose them when it ends.
No teleporting while your troops are out. Castles can no longer stand on a city's or an oasis's edge.
The teleport pin points at the square you chose and keeps one size at every zoom; marching ships and their lines are 25% smaller.

patches.title: The World Tree
items: No more castles on the World Tree: its canopy and roots are blocked for teleports, and a castle already there moves to a random spot in its own region. Attacks on cities, oases and the World Tree march twice as fast. The World Tree holds 15 garrison lines. A held site shows just its garrison count, and the march button sits at the top of the march window.

patches.title: A sharper realm, part 3
items: More of the realm in fine detail, and four regions re-cut to line up exactly with the map underneath.

patches.title: Oriel
items: Oriel, the capital, is rebuilt as a castle on its hill inside a walled ring, and more of the realm is in fine detail.

patches.title: Hero cards
items: Hero cards in your roster are fully framed for every rarity, and each card shows the hero's class (Tank, Bruiser, Mage, Marksman, Assassin or Support).

patches.title: Full screen
items: On phones, swiping down for the status bar no longer shrinks the game.

patches.title: Map refresh
items: The World Map shows the new Ashford and Lanternmere at every zoom (some browsers kept the old map data).

patches.title: Guild holdings
items: Cities, oases and the World Tree belong to guilds: leave your guild (or get removed) and your garrison marches home; a guild that disbands loses what it held.

patches.title: A sharper realm, part 2
items: More of the realm in fine detail, and two cities rebuilt: Ashford is now a moat fortress with a drawbridge, and the capital Lanternmere has a walled upper city and a busy lower town.

patches.title: A sharper realm
items: More of the realm in fine detail: zoom all the way in around Qasrim, Sayle, Hallowrime, Tellary, Groll, Coldharrow, Lanternmere and Hollin, and along the far west coast, to see the sharper art.

patches.title: Hold the city
items: Win a siege and your army stays: it becomes the first garrison line of the city, oasis or World Tree, instead of marching home.
Every held site shows its garrison on the map - 3/8, or 3/10 on a capital (Oriel, Hallowrime, Lanternmere and Durrakh).
On a site your guild holds, the panel offers Defense (send another line, up to the cap) and View Garrison (every line, with Return on your own).
Only guild members can attack a site. A garrisoned site is defended by its garrison's heroes; break them and the old lines march home while yours stay.

patches.title: One sword
items: Hovering a city, oasis or the World Tree with a mouse now shows one sword, not two.

patches.title: Attack the cities
items: Cities, oases and the World Tree can be attacked: hover one on the world map to see the sword, click it to see who holds it and how far away it is, and attack from within 20 squares. Your army marches to its centre and fights its guards - win and it is held by your guild (or by you) for everyone to see.
Marching airships and their dotted trails are sized to the castles again.
A mine your squad is gathering stays on the map, with its timer, until it is used up.

patches.title: Smooth map zoom
items: Zooming the world map is smooth: the sharper tiles load before the old ones go, and a quick second zoom no longer drops tiles.

patches.title: Every Spire ability fires
items: Swarm Spire: every hero's abilities now fire - Aldren's Final Volume summons his Elder Ink Horror, ten aimed shots (Abyssal Needle, Thornshot, Grappling Hook and more) hit enemies instead of healing, and dashes strike where they land.

patches.title: More of the north-east in fine detail
items: More of the north-east is painted in fine detail: zoom in across the north-east coast to see it sharp.
Enemy Vael on 4-3 heals less with Last Stand and hits a little softer (your own Vael is unchanged).
Emberdraft: the solo button now reads PLAY VS NPCS.
New Terms of Service and Privacy Policy (October 2026) - you'll be asked to accept them once. Deleting your account now gives you 7 days to change your mind: sign in again to cancel.

patches.title: New cities and a sharper north-east
items: The north-east of the realm is painted in twice the detail: zoom in there to see it sharp.
Four new cities rise on the map: Ochreth, Hallowrime, Lanternmere and Skarrow (16 in all).
Lake and harbour cities are solid ground for the city: no castle can teleport onto Groll's lake any more.
The world map no longer jumps to the open sea when you come back to it, sign in again, or drag while it refreshes.

patches.title: A finer world map
items: The world map grid is finer: 1000 squares across. Each castle fits in one square, and mines sit where four squares meet.
Zoom in much closer: the tightest view is 16 of the new squares across.
The map now fills the whole screen, and the buttons are slimmer and see-through. The bottom bar folds away with the small arrow.
Castle names show on two lines, and mines show just their level.

patches.title: The realm map: the whole world in one picture
items: The world map is now one painted realm: 4 continents around the World Tree island, with the wild islands out in the sea between them.
12 cities sit on their own land, and the wild regions keep their own names.
Zoom out to see the whole realm at once, or in close: the tightest view is 16 squares across.
The World Tree changes by day and by hour, and the tree on the map now shows exactly that stage.

patches.title: Five more Spire heroes
items: The Swarm Spire: 5 more heroes are playable in full 3D - Tolley, Carn, Quorrel, Vulmar and Rhukk - 55 heroes in all. Ranged heroes now attack the way they do in battle: Rafe fires his pistol, Yenna, Meridian, Mellan, Oakmir and Sorrel throw, Fritz thrusts his palm and Calypsa lashes. Gruel and Seyla leap into their ults.

patches.title: Fifty heroes in the Swarm Spire
items: The Swarm Spire: 48 more heroes are now playable, each in full 3D with their own walk, run, attack, cast and ult - 50 heroes in all. Melee heroes now swing, stab, slash or bash at what is in front of them instead of shooting, with attacks that match how they fight in battle, and every hero levels up with their own class's powers.

patches.title: Spells that work in the Swarm Spire
items: The Swarm Spire: Zahri joins Linnet as a playable hero, in full 3D, and every hero now appears in the Spire roster - more become playable as their 3D models arrive. Skills now do what they say - stuns, slows, pulls, bleeds and armor breaks land on every enemy they hit. Zahri's Mirage Herd calls up her mirage to fight beside you, and her Noonday Stampede has new spell art.
The Swarm Spire hero list now scrolls, so every hero shows at full size on a phone.
In the Swarm Spire, Zahri's basic attack now flies as her own golden lance crescent.
Fixed: on the campaign map, a background sync could flip the chapter back while you were looking at the next one, so tapping a stage opened the wrong one.

patches.title: Real skills in the Swarm Spire
items: The Swarm Spire: your hero now fights with their real skills - each skill button and the ult plays the hero's own spell art, and Linnet's basic attack flies her needle. Pause to see your full build. Guardian Spirits now circle you and strike much harder, and the Reach passive now widens every ability. The old tower can no longer be opened from the Spire screen.

patches.title: The Swarm Spire
items: The Tower of Trials is now The Swarm Spire, with a new hero select screen: pick your hero from twenty, choose Story or Survive and the stage, then play. Linnet is ready now; more heroes join as they are brought to life in 3D. Pause any time to see your skills, spells and passives, and Save and quit to carry on later from the exact same spot. The Ascendant Spire is one tap away on the same screen.

patches.title: Hero Survivors preview
items: Tower of Trials: a first look at Hero Survivors. Linnet takes on the endless hordes of Emberfall Vale in 3D - move with the joystick, her spells fire on their own, and her skills and ult are the buttons on the right.

patches.title: Gravemaw Pull spell effect
items: Grosk's Gravemaw Pull has a new spell effect: a violent rush of air and dust streams into Grosk from the enemies around him as he drags them in.

patches.title: Grosk, Fritz and Hobb spell effects
items: New spell effects for Grosk, Fritz and Hobb. Grosk's Hammer Fists: each of his three punches now lands with a grey shockwave burst from his fist, in place of the old stone-fist badge. Fritz: Storm Surge brings a lightning strike down on each enemy it hits, Chain Lightning arcs a crackling bolt from target to target, and Thunder Shower gathers a storm cloud over him that rains lightning around him for the whole channel. Hobb's Glazebreaker: his paddle now shatters a glazed jar on the enemy into a spray of blue-and-white shards.

patches.title: Starless Well carry
items: Starless Well: the HP and energy your heroes carry to the next fight are now always kept in range (HP between 1% and full, energy between empty and a full bar), even when the result you watched differs from the server's replay.

patches.title: Arena defense team
items: Arena: the defense team you pick under Defenders - Adjust now really defends you. Attackers see it in their opponent preview and fight it; before, your main team always defended. With no defense team picked, your main team defends as before. War mail: attack and defense reports are now saved on your account before the server lets go of them, so a crash or reload can no longer lose them, and a report never arrives twice.

patches.title: Skyfall and Market display fixes
items: Skyfall: each of your lines on the war board now shows its kills out of 5, replacing an old 'orders' counter that could go below zero. Market: the Peace Shield always shows the price you will actually pay, even if you level up within the hour.

patches.title: Display fixes
items: Display fixes: the Watchtower no longer lists your own stationed city defenders as incoming attacks; a Campaign stage's details now show sweepability, stamina and runs for the mode you picked (Veteran no longer says 'sweepable' from your Normal stars).

patches.title: Embassy fixes
items: Embassy fixes: Envoy's Favor now really adds +5% guild contribution exp per guild level, and the Contribute button shows the boosted amount. The Embassy no longer lists a max-stamina perk; your stamina bar now shows the true maximum. Mines now pay their full designed yield per haul (no more flat 15), and Miner's Charter really adds +3% per guild level.

patches.title: Getting Started fix
items: Getting Started rewards now check that the lesson is really done before paying out. Players who play the lessons get exactly the same rewards as before.

patches.title: Desktop fix
items: On desktop, the bars beside the game are plain black again; they no longer show a second copy of the town map. Tall phones keep the art in their margins.

patches.title: Hero screen fix
items: Tall phone screens now keep the game, touch controls and popup exits aligned in landscape, with battlefield art filling the margins. The mute button respects the window in front. Starting a Vault fight now waits for the attempt to be saved before confirming it.

Iver, Joss and Ambrel have all-new battle animations, and Ambrel a new death. New spell effects for Aureth's Sunburst, Duality and Eclipse, Aldren's Chapter Rewrite, and Joss's Radiant Hammer, Sanctuary Guard and Daybreak Judgment; Sanctuary Guard is now half its size and stays behind the heroes.

Fixed a freeze in the tutorial: leaving a hero's Skills or Glyphs and closing the Heroes window could leave a black screen with only the music playing. Closing any window now always returns you to a working screen.

New spell effects for Tolley's Forge Strike, Chain Quench and Living Forge: the molten hammer slams down on the target, his chains lash out to every enemy they pull before the quench bursts around him, and the Living Forge burns under his feet as he walks. The opening screen is now silent and has no mute button; sound and the button start on the next screen. The victory and defeat screens now wait for the last death animation to finish. Switching servers no longer shows a false "You've been logged out" notice. Nerisse's Drifting Constellation effect is half its old size.
Hero deaths look cleaner: the pink tint and grey patches left in the ash, and the grey flash in Hurne's death, are gone for 59 heroes; Lumi and Oakmir have new death animations.
The World Map screen always has a way back to your town, even before it unlocks or while your castle is still being found.
Fixed a hidden graphics error that repeated in every battle after a hero's death animation ended.
On a slow or dropped connection the game no longer waits forever: a screen that cannot load says so and offers Try again, and a claim or purchase that was slow to answer is never paid twice.

patches.title: Server safety
items: Server data safety improvements: a server that cannot read its saved world now stops safely instead of starting fresh, saves are fully written to disk before they count, and backups of real player progress are always kept.
Absalie, Aldren, Ambrel, Askel Greatbrow, Astra, Aureth, Bloatus and Brannus now have their own death animations.
Calypsa Prismfin, Carn, Ceraline, Dandra, Deepcleft, Fritz, Grimsby and Grosk now have their own death animations.
New spell effects for Kharos's Petal Sever, Bloomstep and Orchid Execution.

Bloomstep: Kharos now vanishes into the petal storm, then appears behind the enemy and strikes with the counter's 2.1x damage: behind the one that hit him, or behind his target when the 2.2 seconds end.
Signing up and signing in stay quick when many players join at once: new accounts no longer fail with "Accounts are unreachable" during a rush.
Tessit's Hourglass has a new spell effect: the hourglass shatters over the enemies, its sand hangs frozen in the air while they are stunned, then falls.
Gruel, Hobb Kilnmask, Hollow, Hurne, Iver, Joss Gatley, Kharos Bloomknife and KonWu now have their own death animations.
Death animations now load in small pieces while they play, so phones use much less memory in big fights.
New spell effects for Hollow's Fan of Knives, Lacerate and Vanishing Point, and a new Fan of Knives animation: he draws five knives and throws them.
Hollow's Fan of Knives: the knives now fly out twice as fast.

All 60 heroes now have their own death animations: Korvux, Linnet, Lumi, Lysara Moonveil, Maren, Mellan, Meridian, Mirelle Velvetplum, Nerisse Bellglass, Nox Quillfinger, Oakmir, Orryn, Pellucid, Pyroclast, Quorrel, Rafe Marrow, Rhukk, Rivet, Seyla Silkcoil, Sloe, Sorrel, Tessit, Tharl Ironcoil, Tick, Tolley, Umbris, Vaelora Velvetclaw, Vesper, Veyr, Vulmar, Yenna Cacklefang and Zahri Sunhorn join today.
Saving is much lighter with many players online: actions and fights answer faster, and new players joining no longer slow the server down.

patches.title: Pre-beta: music and the mute button
items: The game now has music: ten songs each for the city, the maps, battles and Skyfall, shuffled with a soft crossfade.
Battle songs start where the action starts, and keep playing on the rewards screen until you tap Continue.
A mute button is on every screen, and Settings > Audio has Mute all.
The mute button now has its own fixed spot on each screen, and no longer covers other buttons or titles.
Fixed: lag in the Heroes window and other busy screens. The hero list scrolls smoothly.
Veyr and Deepcleft: eight new animations each, and new spell effects for Veyr's Gravity Crescent, Abyssal Mantle and Abyssal Undertow.
Korvux: eight new animations, and Ember Cleave's effect now follows his axe swing.
New spell effects for Vael's Warcry, Bloodthirst and Last Stand, and Deepcleft's Fault Claws, Burrow Guard and Quarry Collapse.
New spell effects for Mirelle's Scent of Courage, Soporific Bouquet and Imperial Plumage.
Mirelle's Imperial Plumage feather bursts are now small and no longer overlap each other.
Nox Quillfinger: eight new animations, and he is now a mid-row ranged magic assassin. His attacks fly up to 10 m as a shadow ball and deal magic damage.
Grimsby: seven new animations.
Meridian: seven new animations.
Rafe Marrow: ten new animations, with his pistol and his cutlass each getting their own attack and critical strike. Every shot and cut now lands on the moment his animation shows it.
Hobb Kilnmask: eight new animations, including his first critical strike.
Kharos Bloomknife: ten new animations. His attacks now alternate between his two blades, and his Perfect Camouflage fades him to a see-through figure.
Brannus: eight new animations, including his first critical strike, and new spell effects for Rim Breaker, Arena Lock and Lionwheel Rampage.
Quorrel: eight new animations, including his first critical strike.
Rim Breaker now flies at the furthest enemy within 10 m, striking and stunning every enemy along its path, and Brannus throws the wheel through the air instead of rolling it.
Vael, Sylthaine, Vex and Vireo now have their own death animations.
Weapon strike sounds are 15% quieter.
Spell sounds now play to their natural end and ring out with a soft sparkle.
Melee swings carry a magic shimmer, and each swing sounds a little different from the last.
Skill previews on the hero panel now play each hero's real battle animation, spell effect and sound.
Restart Stage now stops the old fight at once: its music, sounds and spell effects end before the new fight begins.
The chat bar now shows only in the city and on the world map.
Fixed: the game could say the server was lost while the connection was fine.
On desktop, Esc returns to the city and Backspace goes back one menu.
Character names can now use numbers and common symbols.

patches.title: Pre-beta opens
items: Pre-beta is open. Every diamond pack in the shop is free during pre-beta, and free packs count toward your Patron level.
Combat has sound: every attack, spell, ultimate and passive, timed to land on the hit.
New animations for Maren, Orryn, Sylthaine, Carn and Aureth. Aureth's light and dark sword swings each have their own sound.
Rivet now cycles through ten weapons: gatling, revolver, flying saw, bolt and chest cannon at range; blade, hammer and two spikes up close. His chain hook pulls back enemies who walk away.
Astra's ultimate is now Collapsing Star. Veyr has his own ultimate, Abyssal Undertow: it drags enemies in and slows them for 2 seconds.
Hollow: Vanishing Point damage reduced by 40%, he drops into the fight 2 seconds later, and his base attack is 10% lower.
Hurne's Feed Them always casts: +10% damage, attack speed and damage reduction for 10 seconds, plus 3% for each beast he devours.
Aureth's basic attacks deal 70% physical and 30% magic damage, one swing every 1.8 seconds.
Stage 1-10 enemies deal 15% less damage on Normal, Elite and Veteran.
Stage 1-1 now teaches ultimates on your first clear: the fight pauses when each hero's ultimate is ready and shows where to aim it.
Veteran now covers all 16 chapters: each stage is its Normal stage at double strength, with bigger rewards, and pays twice Elite's hero fragments on the same stages.
Wishing Pool: new Diamond Pool odds, every pool shows its odds on its card, and the Gold Pool now holds every 1-star hero.
New item: Ember Roast, worth 120 stamina, from the Diamond Pool.
You now sign in or create an account before playing, and a GUEST marker shows when you are playing as a guest.
Fixed: a won fight could show DEFEAT when the connection dropped. Results now retry, and a win is never shown as a loss.
Fixed: the victory screen always showed 3 stars. It now shows the stars you earned in that fight; the map keeps your best.
Fixed: summoned units now fight at the battle's level.
Chapters 10 to 15 have new full-width phone maps.
Debuff icons and marks now sit at a hero's feet.
Fewer phone crashes in and after battles, and much smaller battle art downloads.

patches.title: Askel, Hurne and Vael's story
items: Askel Greatbrow: five new animations, including his first crit.
Hurne: a new attack and his first crit.
New spell art for Vesper's Puncture and Vex's Razor Tempest.
Vael's lore is updated, on screen and in his voice.
Fixed: level 9 and 10 mines were missing from the world map for signed-in players.
Stages 12-4, 14-1, 14-3, 14-8 and 15-6 made easier: enemies have 15% less health and damage (Elite follows).

patches.title: Academy, armor and Vael's voice
items: Vael is the first hero with a voice: tap play above his lore to hear him tell it. His lore is rewritten to match.
Academy: the Defense track is gone, Healing and Shielding is new, Crit and Crit Resist reach 10% at level 60, and Attack and Ability Power research are now equal.
Crit Resist now reduces the attacker's crit damage, and a new Defense stat lowers the attacker's crit chance.
Monsters now have their own Armor and Magic Resist: some shrug off physical damage, others magic.
Team select screens: five hero slots on top, class tabs, and a five-column hero grid.
Starless Well: every fight won pays an XP potion, chests pay diamonds, and a sweep pays 80% of a full run's rewards.
New animations for Gruel, Grosk, Umbris, Hollow and Pellucid.

Grosk: Hammer Fists is now 3 punches at 60% Attack, each landing as the fist reaches full length. Croc Drop can be aimed (6 m range) and is weaker: 10% of max health at skill level 1, up to 20% at level 100. The Mirewall grows from 20% to 35% by level 100.
Every skill now gains something from each level, and skill cards show the levelled numbers.
Ceraline's wax cuts healing on the enemy by 30%.
AUTO now fires healer ultimates as soon as they are ready.
New spell art for Astra, Korvux, Sorrel, Carn, Tharl Ironcoil, Kon-Wu, Rhukk, Ceraline and Vex.
Skill animations now play through to the hit before the next swing.
Campaign chapters 4 to 16 smoothed out: spike stages trimmed and every stage 15% easier. Stages 5-6, 7-3, 11-4, 11-7, 11-8, 12-2, 12-6, 12-9, 12-10, 13-2, 13-3 and 14-1 also eased (Elite follows).
Battles run smoother: nothing loads in the middle of a fight.
When a server is down, the game says which one and lists the others.
Fixed: knocked-up units could stay in the air for the whole fight.
The Forge shows newly earned parts straight away, and the Vault sweep shows a tidy reward summary.

patches.title: The Temple of Ash, rebuilt
items: The Temple of Ash is rebuilt: every hero has four prayer bars of its own, 60 new hero portraits, and blessings drawn from its own skills. The 5th dot adds 15% to blessings.
Prayers roll a gain or a loss across your open bars, with a chance of a 2x or 3x breakout. Auto pray opens at Temple 12, and free and held prayers stack on one row.

Patron levels: buying diamonds raises your Patron level, with rebates and daily perks such as more meals, gold buys, city attacks and armies out at once. 2x speed and auto ultimates now need Patron level 1.
The Mythical Pool opens at Patron 11: 400 diamonds a wish, featuring the mythical heroes Kon-Wu, Vulmar, Aureth, Hurne and Hollow.
Wishing Pool: new background and emblems, odds behind a ? button, and the screen fits better.
Game art icons replace emojis across the game, and hero fragments now show that hero's card.
Oakmir: seven new animations and a new passive, Deep Roots, which roots and heals an ally below 30% health for 25% of max health over 4 seconds, once per fight. His First Spring flowers are smaller.

New spell art for Sloe's Emerald Volley, Zahri's Solar Impalement and Noonday Stampede, Linnet's Rewrite the Pattern, Rafe Marrow's Dead Man's Fortune, and Ceraline's Sealing Wax and Court of the Final Candle.
Ceraline: Court of the Final Candle can be aimed and encases everyone the wax touches. Living Tallow encases for 1 second, plus 0.015 seconds per skill level.
Stamina meals come in pairs: ten a day at 50, 50, 100, 100, 200, 200, 400, 400, 600 and 600 diamonds.
Every daily reset now happens at 09:00 ET.
Arena coins and protection shields are now kept with your account.
Chat: block and report other players. You can also delete your account.
Stages 6-2, 6-5, 7-3, 7-7, 9-8, 10-1 and 3-10 made easier: enemies have 15% less health and damage (Elite follows). Vault floors 28 to 30, 44 and 49 eased the same way.
Bosses 2-10 and 6-10 are 15% stronger.
Fixed: Temple orbs drew over the hero filter menu.

patches.title: Kon-Wu, sound settings and the Forge
items: Kon-Wu: eight new animations. Phantom Step is now a dropkick that knocks the target 8 m back and stuns it for 2 seconds while he chases at 1.5x speed. Cleaving Arc now reaches 5 m.

New spell art for Vulmar's Gravity Sling, Vireo's Crescendo, Harmony and Perfect Pitch, Maren's Tide Pool, Maelstrom and Deep Reserves, Rhukk's Impale Rush and Thick Chitin, Orryn's spells and Pellucid's Meteor Knuckle, Infernal Clinch and Worldbreaker Fists.
Bloatus's Toxic Breath is now a green gas plume from his mouth.
Every walk now plays as one smooth stride.
Settings has an Audio section with its own FX, Music and Voices volumes.
Tharl Ironcoil: nine new animations.
Forge: Temper now belongs to the item, so every copy of an item shares its Temper.
Elite stages are now 1.5 times as hard as their Normal stage in every chapter.
Stages 3-10, 4-10 and 5-9 made easier: enemies have 15% less health and damage. Vault floor 1 enemies have 40% less.
City attack reports are kept in your war mail, up to 50.

patches.title: Every hero has a name
items: Every hero now has a name and a title, shown on the hero panel. Named for the first time: Aldren, Ambrel, Tolley, Mellan, Rafe Marrow, Ceraline, Quorrel, Brannus, Sorrel, Linnet, Iver, Sloe, Absalie, Joss Gatley and Hobb Kilnmask.

Vael: new animations and new lore. Bloodthirst gives +20% attack speed, Warcry makes enemies within 5 m flee for 2 seconds, Blood Rage adds up to 25% damage as he takes damage, and his sword deals damage the moment it lands.
Attack speed now speeds up the attack animation too, and feared enemies run away instead of standing still.
Fritz: new animations. Thunder Shower is back to its original storm, Chain Lightning bounces to 4 enemies up to 15 m apart, and his basic attack fires a bolt.
Bloatus: new animations. Swampcall hits the two farthest enemies, rooting and silencing for 2 seconds, and Plague Sovereign's radius grows from 3.4 m to 5 m.
Magic tanks (Bloatus, Ambrel, Joss Gatley) no longer crit with basic attacks. Their spells still can.
Rhukk: nine new animations, and Impale Rush charges with its animation.
Balance: marksmen, assassins and bruisers gain far more Attack from glyphs, mage Ability Power is lower, melee tanks gain Attack, and skills grow 1.20% per level.

Balance: health regen is capped at 1.2% of max health per second. Marksman gear is stronger, bruiser and tank gear gives less health, and the attack assassins (Sorrel, Hollow, Kharos, Nox, Seyla, Vex) now wear attack gear.
Tank health at max: about 22,000 for melee tanks and 18,000 for magic tanks.
In auto-resolved fights (marches, mines, war lines) both sides now cast their ultimates.
New health and energy bars over every hero and at the bottom of the screen.
Buff badges over a hero's head now scroll: the newest slides in on top and pushes the older ones out.
Spell effects no longer linger after a fight ends. Vireo's ultimate and Crescendo art are smaller.
The Academy now runs to level 120, the Witches Hut can be upgraded, and map resources have their names: Emberite, Voidglass, Starsilver and Cinderwood.
March pickers no longer offer heroes at 0% health, and Starless Well squares show their XP potions.
An arena or guild raid fight that did not count now says NOT COUNTED instead of showing a false result.
The guild contribute screen now shows its real price: 200 gold for 100 guild experience.
The Market shows how many fragment buys you have left today.
You now need to be online to play.
Fixed: a dropped connection could lose a mine haul or battle loot.

patches.title: Spells land when they hit
items: Spells now take effect when their art reaches the target: bolts fly, blows fall and areas form before the damage, stun or heal lands.
Charges are real dashes: heroes and monsters run at their target and strike on arrival. Grosk's ultimate is a real leap.
New spell art for Pellucid, Pyroclast, Orryn, Nerisse, Calypsa, Seyla Silkcoil, Veyr, Absalie, Vex, Vireo, Rivet, Ceraline, Rhukk, Kharos, Lysara, Tolley and Vulmar.
Seyla Silkcoil's Serpent's Last Dance: a star circles her four times, striking each enemy it passes and finishing anyone under 10% health.
Nerisse's Drifting Constellation orb now bounces from ally to ally and heals each one as it arrives.
Pellucid's Worldbreaker Fists: three slams, each sending out a shockwave that strikes and staggers.
Vulmar's Weight of the World lifts every enemy in the circle for 2 seconds, then slams them down for a 1-second stun.
Ceraline's new Sealing Wax replaces Waxen Effigy, and Court of the Final Candle turns enemies into wax statues that shatter.
Fixed spells that did nothing: Tharl Ironcoil's Layered Hide, Pellucid's Unmovable Mass and Linnet's Rewrite the Pattern revive. Joss Gatley's Daybreak Judgment now stuns.
Ultimates fire the moment you tap them.
Ten spells that had no description now have one.
Skill previews show the hero casting the spell, with its effect, on a battle arena.
World map: four painted oases around the World Tree, and the countdown now sits at the tree's roots.
Marches cross the Void at half speed, and you can now teleport right up to the crystals.
Resource nodes no longer appear on crystals or inside the Void, and there is no daily mining limit.
The Watch Tower shows your guildmates' trips, and city marches have a Retreat button.
Buff and debuff words now stack and scroll instead of overlapping.
Battles run smoother: spell art loads before the fight and is cleared after it.
Chapters 11 to 16 show their bosses on the chapter intro and the map.
Pyroclast: eight new animations.
A Server button in the menu lists the servers and which are up. One account works on every server, with separate progress on each, and switching keeps you signed in.
Rewards, purchases and world map actions are now saved before they are confirmed, so a server restart cannot lose them.
Fixed: Kharos fought in the Hourglass Sentinel boss's look.
Fixed: the game could fail to load on a device that had played recently.

patches.title: The World Tree wakes
items: The World Tree on the world map now withers and regrows on a two-week cycle, and a timer under the tree counts down to its next event.
The first World Tree event is Saturday 3 October at 8 AM ET, then every two weeks - on the weekends between Guild Wars.
The event itself (capturing and healing the tree) is not open yet - this is the tree and its timer.

patches.title: Guild Wars every other week
items: Skyfall Guild Wars now run every other week. Sign-ups open Saturday 02:00 and close Monday 00:00 server time; battles stay Tuesday to Friday, 6-8 PM ET.
The first fortnightly sign-up opens Saturday 10 October, then every two weeks.
The Skyfall calendar marks the sign-up and battle days ahead.

patches.title: The Temple of Ash opens
items: The Temple of Ash is open in your town, with its rituals from Kindled to Inferno.
Temple orbs now glow on your hero cards, and the town has a new Temple backdrop.
New players can fight one-on-one straight after a reset.
Hero levels now sit in the corner of each card.
Fixed: purchased diamonds and wallet changes could roll back.

patches.title: The World Map, in full detail
items: 81 hand-painted close-up pieces of the world map, sharp right to their edges.
The whole-map view is now as detailed as the zoomed-in views.
The map loads far faster (309 MB down to 76 MB).

patches.title: The Starless Well and the 16-chapter campaign
items: New: The Starless Well - a three-day run of 5v5 fights toward the boss at the centre, with Normal and Hard portals.
The campaign now runs to 16 chapters and 160 stages, with six new maps and the World Tree.
Elite stages cover all 16 chapters, and chapters 11 to 16 add 96 new bonus stages.
The quest chain now runs all the way to level 160.
The Vault now opens at level 10.

patches.title: Skyfall and guild banners
items: Skyfall, the weekly guild war: hold towers, place your lines and climb the bracket to the cup.
Officers can move a whole tower at once, and finished tournaments keep their results forever.
Guild banners: 20 shapes, 20 emblems and 20 colours, or upload your own picture.
Every hero shows its power wherever you pick it.

patches.title: Emberdraft and the guild raid
items: New: Emberdraft - draft a team round by round on the Island of Trials and watch it fight.
The guild raid boss is now a real 90-second battle your whole guild fights.

patches.title: The Gauntlet and a new title screen
items: Bonus stages arrive in the campaign with the Gauntlet.
A new animated title splash.

patches.title: Animation & studio update
items: Heroes render at a consistent size across every animation.
Role-based battlefield sizing: tanks are largest, backline mages smallest.
Xanthyr Games branding and studio logo added.

patches.title: Terms & accounts
items: A Terms of Service step on first sign-in.
Cloud accounts: sign in and sync progress across devices.
Installable app support.
